quiz.q: Ifeoma's total cost for a gown is ₦30,000 (approximate) and she wants 25 percent profit. What price should she quote?
quiz.explain: ₦30,000 × 1.25 = ₦37,500. Profit is added on top of all costs.

quiz.q: Monthly overheads are ₦120,000 and you finish 30 garments a month. What is the overhead charge per garment?
A customer sends a screenshot of a transfer and asks to collect her gown immediately. What should you do?
options: Release the gown, a screenshot is proof
Check your bank or wallet app to confirm the money has arrived before releasing it
Ask her to send the screenshot again
quiz.explain: Fake transfer alerts and edited screenshots are a known scam. Only your own banking app confirms payment.

quiz.q: Why can an aso-ebi gown often be priced lower than an identical one-off gown?
options: Pattern and grading time is shared across many gowns and batch work is faster
Group clients do not need fittings
Overheads do not apply to group orders
quiz.explain: The base pattern and grading are done once and shared, and batch cutting and sewing reduce labour per gown.

quiz.q: Which detail photo best shows a client the quality of your work?
options: A dark photo taken at night
Close-ups of matched print at the seams and the inside finishing
A photo of the empty shop
quiz.explain: Clients pay for details such as print matching and neat finishing; clear daylight close-ups show them.

quiz.q: The wedding is on the 30th. Which plan is most professional?
options: Schedule two fittings and deliver a few days before the 30th
Skip the toile to save time
Agree no dates and call when ready
quiz.explain: Planning back from the event with fittings and a buffer protects both you and the client.

finalQuiz.q: Which statement about a bodice block is correct?
options: It includes seam allowances and design details
It is a plain fitted shape without seam allowance, used as the base for styles
It is cut directly from the client's fabric
It is only needed for menswear
finalQuiz.explain: A block is the tested, plain fitted shape. Styles and seam allowances are added on patterns traced from it.

finalQuiz.q: Before measuring, a client is wearing a thick padded bra she will not wear with the gown. What should you do?
options: Ask her to change into the bra she will wear under the garment
finalQuiz.explain: Bra style changes the bust measurement by several centimetres. Measure over the undergarments she will actually wear.

finalQuiz.q: Waist 84 cm, waist ease 4 cm. What is the waist measurement per quarter on the block?
finalQuiz.explain: 84 ÷ 4 = 21 cm plus 4 ÷ 4 = 1 cm ease gives 22 cm.

finalQuiz.q: The bust line quarter is 26 cm and the waist quarter is 21 cm. You take 2 cm at the side seam. How much goes into the waist dart?
finalQuiz.explain: 26 − 21 = 5 cm to remove. With 2 cm at the side seam, 3 cm goes into the dart.

finalQuiz.q: Which method moves a dart by cutting a paper copy to the bust point and closing the old dart?
finalQuiz.explain: Slash and spread cuts to the bust point, closes the old dart and lets the new one open.

finalQuiz.q: In a toile, the front neckline gapes. What is a sensible correction?
options: Pin out a small wedge from the neckline to the bust point and move it into the bust dart
finalQuiz.explain: Gaping at the front neck is extra length there. Removing it as a wedge to the bust point and moving it into the dart keeps the fit elsewhere.

finalQuiz.q: A brocade has a raised, shiny pattern with a clear direction. How should pattern pieces be laid?
options: In any direction to save fabric
All facing the same direction, on grain
finalQuiz.explain: Brocade and damask often have a nap or directional sheen, so all pieces must face the same way to look the same colour.

finalQuiz.q: A 6-yard ankara piece is about how many metres long?
When grading a bodice one size up with a 4 cm bust change, which part should change least?
finalQuiz.explain: Girths change most. The neck point moves only about 0.2 cm for a 1 cm neck change.

finalQuiz.q: Which seam finish suits an unlined aso-oke jacket best?
finalQuiz.explain: Aso-oke is thick and frays. A bound seam encloses the edge neatly and looks good inside an unlined jacket.

finalQuiz.q: Materials ₦6,000, labour ₦18,000, overhead ₦3,000 (all approximate). With 20 percent profit, what is the price?
Which item best shows growth in a certificate reflection?
options: "Waist sat 2 cm high in the toile; I lengthened the bodice 2 cm and it now sits on the natural waist"
finalQuiz.explain: A strong reflection names a specific problem, the correction and the measured result.

capstone.title: Pattern-to-garment portfolio project
capstone.brief: Make one complete fitted garment for a real person from blocks you drafted yourself, with a style created by dart manipulation or a style line. Submit an evidence pack: measurement card, labelled blocks, toile fitting photos and corrections, working pattern, fabric test and layout, inspection results, costing sheet and order form, finished garment photos, a feedback reflection and a 90-day plan.
steps: Measure the client, cross-check and record a dated measurement card.
Draft a bodice block and a skirt block with planned ease, and label them.
Sew and fit a calico toile, photograph it, and correct the paper blocks.
Create the working pattern for the chosen style and add seam allowances, notches and grain lines.
Test and prepare the fabric, plan the layout, calculate yardage, then cut and sew.
Inspect the finished garment against a written spec and tolerances and fix any defects.
Cost and price the garment, collect specific feedback, and write a reflection and a 90-day plan.
